courses.note: Required. C3 is CSC 241 (Data Structures and Algorithms), so the required Computer Systems course CSC 231 qualifies under the systems-first rule; required CSC 301 Computer Security & Ethics is the alternative. Instructor course website; the term is Fall 2023 (course runs August 28 to December 11, 2023), two sections (in-person and online) on one syllabus. The text does not mention AI. No 2025-26 version found.

notes: Requirements read from the BS Computer Science page: nine core CSC courses (141, 142, 220, 231, 240, 241, 301, 345, 402). The department site has no live per-course syllabus links for C1-C3 (old csc14x.aspx pages return 404); the page directs students to the chair or office for syllabi. Syllabi are likely in D2L.
